subject: Unable to deploy Shiny app: Invalid control character

messages.author: 1f4788b2494346da
messages.subject: Unable to deploy Shiny app: Invalid control character
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to deploy a very simple Shiny app.
It consists of 3 R scripts: ui.R, server.R and helper.R
The functions in helper.R use functions from the diagram package.

It runs fine on my laptop, but when I try to deploy it, I get an error about an invalid control character (char 17841); I've pasted the error message below.
I really can't see where this invalid character could be, and how I could fix this error.

Many thanks,

Wim

  error: Parsing manifest
################################## Begin Log ################################## 
################################### End Log ################################### 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 33787718 error: Unhandled Exception: Invalid control character at: line 303 column 8 (char 17841)

messages.author: 1f4788b2494346da
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Unable to deploy Shiny app: Invalid control character
parts:
Problem solved : )

I had some hidden files in the folder in which I had saved the app. Removing these hidden files, solved the problem.
Best regards,

Wim
